posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina praised Alia Bhatt and Sharvari after the Alpha teaser drop, sharing it on her Instagram Stories and calling it 'fire' — rallying the girl squad ahead of the July 3 release.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's much-anticipated film Main Vaapas Aaunga with Imtiaz Ali, Vedang Raina, and Sharvari drops in theatres tomorrow (June 12) — promising a soulful tale of love and longing.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: The Alpha teaser dropped June 10 and has the internet buzzing — Alia plays a deadly assassin trained by Bobby Deol in YRF's Spy Universe thriller, hitting cinemas July 3.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka is the only woman on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities 2026 cover, ranked #3 overall. She's currently shooting Rajamouli's Varanasi with Mahesh Babu.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK ranks #2 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities 2026 list and praised the Alpha teaser. His next film King with Deepika Padukone arrives Christmas Eve.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena continues to be one of Bollywood's most bankable stars, with multiple brand campaigns running and fans eagerly awaiting her next film announcement.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha's biopic Eetha — based on legendary Tamasha artiste Vithabai Narayangaonkar — locks its release for Raksha Bandhan, August 28. Her first film since Stree 2.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Ranked #11 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities, Deepika is gearing up for Atlee's Raka opposite Allu Arjun — reportedly using a body double for intense action scenes.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer is #5 on Fortune India's Most Valuable list after Dhurandhar's massive box office run. His post-apocalyptic thriller Pralay begins shooting in August 2026.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya was named JW Marriott's global brand ambassador and dazzled at Cannes 2026 with daughter Aaradhya. Madhuri Dixit publicly defended her against age-shaming trolls.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika ranked #17 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities 2026 — cementing her pan-India appeal after back-to-back hits across Bollywood and the South.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Gulshan Devaiah joins Samantha's self-produced Telugu film Maa Inti Bangaram. She's also reportedly in talks to star opposite Salman Khan in a Raj & DK superhero project.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Ranked #10 on Fortune India's Most Valuable list, Allu Arjun heaped praise on Ram Charan's Peddi performance and continues shooting Raka with Atlee and Deepika Padukone.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Peddi is a massive hit — crossing ₹260 crore worldwide in its first week, making it Ram Charan's highest-grossing solo lead film. Critics are praising his raw performance.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: War 2 with Hrithik Roshan confirmed for IMAX release on August 14 — marking Jr NTR's Bollywood debut. Telugu distributors have offered a staggering ₹100 crore for the rights.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi is in the spotlight as Peddi co-star alongside Ram Charan, though the film's director had to apologise for controversial scenes involving her character amid online backlash.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya faced heavy trolling over a Bharatanatyam dance sequence in Chand Mera Dil, which underperformed at ₹36 crore. She's now gearing up for Call Me Bae Season 2.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara gave a shoutout to the Alpha teaser and is gearing up for War 2 alongside Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR — the YRF Spy Universe blockbuster releasing August 14.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: War 2 hype is at fever pitch — confirmed for IMAX on August 14 with Jr NTR and Kiara Advani. The trailer promises an epic showdown between two RAW agents fighting for India.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's rom-com Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai crossed ₹30 crore in 5 days since its June 5 release, making it the 10th highest-grossing Bollywood film of 2026 so far.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: India's nightingale continues to captivate audiences with her concert tours and collaborations. Her landmark IPL opening ceremony performance remains a highlight of 2025.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: The maestro is scoring King, Shah Rukh Khan's Christmas release with Anirudh Ravichander handling the film score — a rare dual-composer collaboration for a major Bollywood film.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay made waves in Tamil Nadu politics, narrowly missing the CM seat after the May 2026 elections. His swansong film Jananayagan is now eyeing a July window for release.
